verdict.rationale: Firebase ships 'Gemini in Firebase,' a built-in natural-language assistant in the console that answers product questions, generates code, and provides crash-analysis and messaging-campaign insights — a genuine in-product AI assistant rather than an external tool. However, it reads more as a Q&A/insights assistant than a full task-delegation agent (e.g., no evidence it can autonomously execute multi-step project changes on your behalf), and there is no independent/community corroboration of its real-world effectiveness. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution/delegation beyond Q&A and analysis, and third-party hands-on validation.
